info.title: Replay Crate API
info.description: Records every Spotify play, counts plays per track, manages playlists and serves listening metrics. Every error is JSON `{ error: <code>, ...details }`, and every response carries `X-Request-Id`.

post.description: Called by a hosted scheduler (GitHub Actions, once deployed). Authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`, not a user session.
Exchanges the PKCE authorization code for tokens, stores them encrypted, and starts a session (sets the `rc_session` cookie).
Ends the session, if there is one, and clears the cookie.

Records the user's recently played tracks. Within 30 s of the last sync it returns `skipped` without calling Spotify. `missedPlays` means more than Spotify's last 50 plays happened since the previous sync, so there is a gap (see `/history/gaps`).

post.description: Step 1 of 3. The browser parses the Extended Streaming History export and uploads only timestamp, play time and track id: create, add plays (in chunks), finish.
Step 2 of 3. Up to 5000 plays per request; call as often as needed.
Step 3 of 3. Plays of known tracks move into the history now; unknown tracks are queued for lookup and their plays follow. Closes any history gap the import covers.
